notice.audited: Every time a violation is opened, that is recorded against your name.
notice.immutable: A recorded violation cannot be edited or deleted. A correction is a new, linked record.
notice.inactiveCategory: This violation type is no longer in use. Existing records keep it; new ones cannot use it.
notice.noLegalCheck: Violation types are configuration. No labour-law validation is applied: country packs arrive in a later phase.
notice.noLadder: Penalties and escalation are not part of this release.
notice.investigationAudited: Every time an investigation or a case history is opened, that is recorded against your name.
notice.concludedImmutable: A concluded investigation cannot be edited or deleted.
notice.historyImmutable: A case history is append-only. Nothing rewrites a step that already happened.
notice.derivedState: The current state is worked out from the case history rather than stored, so the two cannot disagree.
notice.oneOpenInvestigation: A violation can have one investigation in progress at a time.
notice.noAutomaticTransitions: Nothing moves a case on its own. Every change here is somebody's decision.
notice.recommendationIsText: A recommendation is a written suggestion. Nothing in this system acts on it automatically.

rejection.category_code_malformed: A code may use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only.
rejection.category_name_incomplete: A violation type needs a name in both English and Arabic.
rejection.category_severity_missing: A violation type needs a severity.
rejection.category_sequence_invalid: The order must be a whole number, zero or more.
rejection.category_repeat_window_invalid: The repeat window must be a whole number of days, zero or more.
rejection.category_pack_source_needs_pack: A country-pack entry must name the pack it came from.
rejection.category_tenant_source_has_pack: An entry defined by this organization cannot name a country pack.
rejection.category_pack_version_invalid: The country pack version must be a whole number, one or more.
rejection.category_inactive: This violation type is no longer in use.
rejection.occurred_on_malformed: The date of conduct must be a calendar date.
rejection.occurred_on_in_future: The date of conduct cannot be in the future.
rejection.reporter_unknown: The person recording this could not be identified.
rejection.access_actor_unknown: The person reading this could not be identified.
rejection.access_correlation_unknown: This read could not be traced to a request.
rejection.transition_not_permitted: This case cannot move that way from where it is now.
rejection.transition_reason_missing: Say why the case is moving.
rejection.transition_actor_unknown: A change must be attributable to somebody.
rejection.opened_on_malformed: Give the date the investigation opened as YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.opened_on_in_future: An investigation cannot open in the future.
rejection.investigator_unknown: Choose who is conducting the investigation.
rejection.concluded_on_malformed: Give the conclusion date as YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.concluded_on_in_future: An investigation cannot conclude in the future.
rejection.concluded_before_opened: An investigation cannot conclude before it opened.
rejection.investigation_already_open: This violation already has an investigation in progress.

conflict.category_code_taken: A violation type already uses that code.
